text: 我猜应该是互相看不上，大叔基本喜欢年轻的，大婶也是…
en: I imagine it's probably that they don't rate each other — older men basically like younger ones, and older women do too…

text: 哈哈
en: Haha

text: 首先，如果不要孩子就不用结婚。
en: First, if you don't want children, there's no need to marry.

text: 如果要孩子，女方四十岁，她就是愿意，你也不能同意。
en: If you do want children, and the woman is forty, even if she's willing, you still can't agree to it.

text: 生育对女方来说风险太大。
en: Childbearing is far too risky for the woman.

text: 另外，男人如果到了中年，想做任何事都必须靠钞能力。
en: Also, once a man reaches middle age, he has to rely on his financial clout to do anything.

text: 在中国，35岁都成了社会淘汰的边角料。
en: In China, even thirty-five already marks you as the offcuts discarded by society's weeding-out.

text: 如果没有过硬的实力，又没有早年积累下来的财富，人到中年，再结合中国这么一个不适合普通人过正常生活的环境，一个普通中年男人可以说情况非常不妙。
en: If you lack solid ability, and also lack the wealth accumulated in your earlier years, then reaching middle age — combined with China being such an environment, unsuited to ordinary people living a normal life — an ordinary middle-aged man can be said to be in a very bad way.

text: 所以一个普通的未婚中国男人到了四十岁，可能都不太会考虑婚姻了。
en: So an ordinary unmarried Chinese man who reaches forty probably won't give much thought to marriage.

text: 凑合活着而已。
en: Just muddling through life, that's all.

text: 这种条件非要找，结果大多不会好。
en: If someone with such circumstances insists on looking, the outcome mostly won't be good.

text: 而且财富差距，对年龄影响其实很大。
en: Moreover, the wealth gap actually has a great effect on age.

text: 一个四十多岁的亿万富豪，和一个四十多岁的失业员工，前者风华正茂一枝花，后者土埋半截一坨翔。
en: A multimillionaire in his forties and an unemployed worker in his forties — the former is in his prime like a single blooming flower, the latter is half-buried in the earth, a lump of shit.

text: 但是到这岁数还想结婚的，肯定都有一些优势条件。
en: But those who still want to marry at this age surely all have some advantageous conditions.

text: 肯定是不太差钱，生活品质不低。
en: They surely aren't short of money, and their quality of life isn't low.

text: 那既然条件不错，肯定是有资本择优了。
en: Well, since their conditions are good, they surely have the capital to be selective.

text: 特别是如果他再有点身家，那就更有必要留个继承人了，从后代角度上讲，也肯定是三十岁以内的最好。
en: Especially if he has some assets of his own, then there's even more reason to leave an heir; and from the angle of offspring, it's surely best to have them under thirty.

text: 40岁男，大脑重新占领高地了。
en: A forty-year-old man — his brain has recaptured the high ground.

text: 22岁男，见社会事件。
en: A twenty-two-year-old man, see social events.

text: 16岁男，见社会事件
en: A sixteen-year-old man, see social events

text: 因为两性关系里，男人的价值主要是钱，女人的价值主要是颜值和身材。
en: Because in heterosexual relationships, a man's value is mainly money, while a woman's value is mainly looks and figure.

text: 如果上升到因为结婚衍生的生育价值，那更不用说了。
en: If it rises to the reproductive value derived from marriage, that goes without saying.

text: 今年46的林志玲，今年70岁的刘晓庆很好找，都有男人在排队
en: Zhi-ling Lin, who is forty-six this year, and Xiaoqing Liu, who is seventy this year, are easy to find partners for — there are men queuing up for both.

text: 结婚就三件事，经济合作，感情交流，性生活。
en: Marriage comes down to three things: economic cooperation, emotional communication, and sex life.

text: 男性年龄越小越看重性生活，年龄越大越看重感情交流，经济合作一般排在最后面。
en: The younger a man is, the more he values sex life; the older he is, the more he values emotional communication; economic cooperation is generally ranked last.

text: 女性不论年龄，经济合作排在第一位，感情交流其次，性生活最后。
en: For women, regardless of age, economic cooperation ranks first, emotional communication second, and sex life last.

text: 经济合作和性生活都是清晰明了的条件，没什么可聊，有就是有，没有就是没有。
en: Economic cooperation and sex life are both clear-cut conditions; there's nothing to discuss — either you have them or you don't.

text: 感情交流，男性认为的人品，女性认为的情绪价值都属于这个范畴，有没有共同话题，能不能聊得下去，都属于感情交流。
en: Emotional communication — the character that men care about and the emotional value that women care about both fall into this category; whether there are shared topics, and whether a conversation can carry on, both belong to emotional communication.

text: 这个条件才是最难达到，实际上大多数夫妻生活三年以后，就没有了感情交流，原因是双方工作和生活环境不一样，想法差别很大，思想很难同频。
en: This condition is the hardest to achieve. In reality, most couples lose their emotional communication after three years of marriage, because their work and living environments differ, their ways of thinking diverge greatly, and it's hard for their minds to be on the same wavelength.

text: 异性之间的话题一离开肉体，远不如同性之间来得亲密自然。
en: Once topics between the opposite sex leave the physical, they are far less intimate and natural than those between the same sex.

text: 结婚几年后，婚姻能不能维持下去，就要靠性生活和孩子，性生活不行，有个孩子也可以，孩子能让双方有共同的话题，如果都没有，这段婚姻基本走到了尽头。
en: A few years after marriage, whether the marriage can be sustained comes down to sex life and children. If the sex life doesn't work, having a child can stand in; a child gives both sides a shared topic. If there's neither, the marriage has essentially reached its end.

text: 40岁的男人，属于既要又要，又想要性生活，还想要感情交流，不会完全放弃哪一条，到底看重哪一条，因人而异。
en: A forty-year-old man wants both this and that — he wants sex life and also wants emotional communication, and won't completely give up either; which one he values most varies from person to person.

text: 40岁的女人，女人的要求一直没变，永远要求比自己优秀一点的男性。
en: A forty-year-old woman — a woman's requirements have never changed; she always demands a man a little better than herself.

text: 条件不好的40岁男性，这时还能生，大概想要一个孩子，感情交流对于条件不好的男性来说是一种奢侈要求，他们看重的就一个，生孩子，等到他们50岁就老实了，只想找个老伴照顾自己了，那时就是经济合作排第一位。
en: A forty-year-old man in poor circumstances can still have children at this point and probably wants a child; emotional communication is a luxury for men in poor circumstances — the one thing they value is having a child. By the time they're fifty they settle down and only want to find an old companion to look after them; then economic cooperation ranks first.

text: 一个男人，他如果很有事业心，八面玲珑，不辞劳苦，熬过35岁中年危机后，40岁了大小也得是个xx总。
en: A man, if he is very career-driven, smooth and versatile, and tireless, after grinding through the thirty-five-year-old middle-age crisis, by forty he'll surely be at least some kind of 'xx boss'.

text: 事实上，很多企业，政府，事业单位，这个年纪的中层领导，绝大部分都是男的。
en: In fact, at many companies, government bodies, and public institutions, the middle managers of this age are overwhelmingly men.

text: 如果一个男的40岁，又油腻又穷，那40岁的女的也瞧不上他。
en: If a man is forty, greasy and poor, then a forty-year-old woman won't fancy him either.

text: 如果一个男的。
en: If a man…

text: 40岁是个事业有成的xx总。
en: Forty is a successful 'xx boss'.

text: xx局。
en: 'xx Bureau.'

text: 就算有家室，外面也是彩旗飘飘。
en: Even if he has a family, outside the colourful flags flutter all around.

text: 养一堆年轻的情人。
en: Keeping a bunch of young lovers.

text: 没有家室那就更不可能瞧上40岁的女的了。
en: If he has no family, then it's even less possible that he'd fancy a forty-year-old woman.

text: 公司招人都知道招35岁以下，朝廷考公都要求不超过35岁，甚至不能超过30岁，以及更多岗位只允许应届生报考。
en: Companies hiring all know to recruit under thirty-five; the court's civil service exams require not exceeding thirty-five, even not exceeding thirty, and more posts only allow fresh graduates to sit them.

text: 公司和朝廷这还只是招工，是要求人干活，理论上从业经验是加分项。
en: And companies and the court are only recruiting here — they need people to do the work, so in theory work experience is a plus.

text: 就这种情况下，公司朝廷都只要年轻人。
en: Yet in this situation, both companies and the court only want young people.

text: 可见40岁的风险不用任何狡辩，全社会全朝廷国家是有共识，亲眼可见的。
en: Thus the risk of being forty needs no sophistry — the whole of society and the entire court-state shares a consensus that is plainly visible.

text: 在这种情况下，40岁的娶40岁，除非是双方资产重大契合，例如某司机接老板的盘，娶大明星，又或者两个公司合并，需要互交投名状。
en: In this situation, a forty-year-old marrying a forty-year-old is only possible if their assets align significantly — for example, a certain driver taking over the boss's seat and marrying a big star, or two companies merging and needing to exchange pledges of allegiance.

text: 除此之外，几乎没有任何理由与收益，让40岁的男女相互动心。
en: Apart from this, there is almost no reason or benefit to make forty-year-old men and women attracted to each other.

text: 而现实是需要公司合并，资产重大契合的毕竟是极少数，这种情况下，没有理由让两个没有信任，没有深度利益的男女走到一起。
en: And in reality, those needing a company merger and significant asset alignment are after all a tiny minority; in such a situation, there is no reason for two men and women with no trust and no deep mutual interest to come together.

text: 所以，在这个阶段，男女正常情况下是不需要也不应该考虑婚姻的，正如小公司小业务的合作，并不需要将两个公司合并，这才是市场上与现实中的正常业务往来。
en: So, at this stage, under normal circumstances men and women neither need nor should consider marriage — just as cooperation between small companies and small businesses doesn't require merging the two companies; that is the normal business dealings in the market and in reality.

text: 也是公司和朝廷，统一选择的外包方式。
en: It is also the outsourcing approach uniformly chosen by companies and the court.

text: 40岁后，男女关系多数情况下下，只有外包，计件的普通合作，极少重资产的全面合并。
en: After forty, in most cases the relationship between men and women is only outsourcing — ordinary piecework-style cooperation, with very few full mergers of heavy assets.

text: 这年纪小头控制不了大头，理智的很
en: At this age the little head can't control the big head — quite rational.

text: 别说40了，我们业主群有个哥们儿，88年的，在群里张罗大家给他相亲，说自己啥要求没有，就想结婚。
en: Not to mention forty — in our homeowners' group there's a mate, born in '88, who keeps organising blind dates for himself in the group, saying he has no requirements at all, he just wants to marry.

text: 我有个91年的姐们儿，体制内，工作稳定，工资高，有房有车，条件好，我赶紧推过去了，那哥儿们一听91年的，就说他年纪也不小了，结婚是为了生孩子，人家说的很委婉，我也懂了
en: I have a female friend born in '91, within the system, with a stable job, high salary, a home and a car, good conditions; I hurriedly put her forward. But as soon as that mate heard '91, he said she wasn't young either, and that marriage is for having children. He put it very tactfully, but I got the message.

text: 在我这个城市，30以上的女性就很难通过相亲向上择偶了，别说向上了，条件相当都很难，据说，人民公园相亲角已经拒收女性简历了
en: In my city, women over thirty already find it hard to marry up through blind dates; never mind marrying up — even finding someone of equal standing is hard. Reportedly, Renmin Park's matchmaking corner has already stopped accepting women's résumés.

text: 谁说不考虑，我堂婶十年前跟着一个外地的跑了，现在我堂叔重新找了一个年纪差不多的过日子，都好几年了。
en: Who says they don't consider it? My uncle's wife ran off with an out-of-towner ten years ago; now my uncle has found another woman of similar age to live with, and that's been several years now.

text: 他们俩都是四十多岁的人。
en: Both of them are in their forties.

text: 我十分确定你要么就是在无病呻吟，要么就是在搞男女对立。
en: I'm quite certain you're either just making a fuss about nothing, or stirring up gender antagonism.
